item.title: Patch now: OpenBSD OpenSSH: Unexpected Status Code or Return Value
item.description:
OpenBSD OpenSSH: Authentication bypass · internet-facing · exploited · fix: 10.6p2 · CCB: patch immediately

First step: Update OpenBSD OpenSSH to 10.6p2 or later.

OpenBSD OpenSSH on Linux contains an unexpected status code or return value vulnerability that could allow for authentication bypass.

High · Fix available · CVE-2026-123158
